description:
Texas Hold'em win odds and pot odds for a hand (Bandit Camp poker). The poker odds page's simulation (https://rust.wiki/calculators/poker-odds): the rest of the board and every
opponent's cards are dealt at random `trials` times. `win_pct` = you win outright, `split_pct` = your share of
split pots, `equity_pct` = both; `margin_pct` is the 95% margin of error. With `to_call`, `pot_odds_need_pct`
(call / (pot + call)) and a `verdict` (call or fold); `made_hands` is how often you end with each hand and how
often that hand wins. Bandit Camp's poker is Rust's in-game scrap game (no rake) - nothing to do with real money. Rust's in-game scrap poker at Bandit Camp, not real-money gambling.

hand.description: Your two cards, e.g. `As,Kd` (ranks 2-10 J Q K A or T, suits s h d c).

opponents.description: Other players still in the hand (1-5, as on the page).

pot.description: Scrap in the pot (for pot odds).

seed.description: Optional random seed for a repeatable answer.

to_call.description: Scrap you need to call (0 = nothing to call).

trials.description: Random deals to simulate (the page uses 20,000; fewer is faster but rougher).
